name.description: Name of the library to generate

directory.description: Optional directory to place the library

plural.description: Plural form of the model name

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing files in the public libraries

filterDepth.description: How many levels of relation nesting the generated filter inputs allow. Each level emits a distinct set of input types; the deepest level carries scalar fields only — it omits nested relation filters AND the AND/OR/NOT logical operators (so logical grouping is unavailable there) — which bounds how deeply a caller can nest relation filters.
